note: Capability matrix for the paper's comparison section (tools/comparison_figures.py). Values: yes / partial / no / nr (not reported in the cited paper, to our reading). Conservative: a capability is marked only when the cited paper or its artifact states it; anything we could not confirm is nr. BenchFuzz entries refer to this repository.

capabilities.name: Golden-model differential oracle
capabilities.source: DifuzzRTL/ProcessorFuzz compare with Spike (Encarsia Sec. 8.1); TheHuzz golden reference model (title); Cascade relies on termination of self-checking programs; ChipFuzzer compares the final architectural state; GoldenFuzz uses Spike as golden reference (abstract); Lyra: differential self-checking with the reference on the ARM cores; HartBreaker: memory-model (litmus) checking, not a golden model

capabilities.name: Check at every retirement
capabilities.source: DifuzzRTL reads state at program end; ProcessorFuzz logs selected internal signals continuously (Encarsia Sec. 8.1); BenchFuzz: RVFI lockstep on PicoRV32, end state on Rocket/BOOM

capabilities.name: Coverage feedback
capabilities.source: control-register / CSR-transition / simulator coverage in the respective papers; Cascade generates without coverage feedback; BenchFuzz: mutation on PicoRV32 only, none on Rocket/BOOM

capabilities.name: Learned / LLM test generation
capabilities.source: ChipFuzzer LLM; GenHuzz RL policy; GoldenFuzz and Lyra generative models; BenchFuzz validated LLM templates (Sec. llmgen) and target-line generator

capabilities.name: Reference calibration + replay of every detection
capabilities.source: BenchFuzz: calibration gate and replay confirmation with reported false-alarm counts; not described in the other papers to our reading

capabilities.name: Failure minimisation
capabilities.source: Cascade prunes failing programs; HartBreaker states failing tests cannot yet be reduced; BenchFuzz: slicing + ddmin/HDD on PicoRV32 only

capabilities.name: Repair with formal certification
capabilities.source: none of the fuzzers repairs RTL; BenchFuzz: gated LLM/template repair certified by Yosys equivalence on PicoRV32

capabilities.name: FPGA acceleration
capabilities.source: TurboFuzz on-SoC; Lyra DUT on FPGA; TurboFuzz compares against FPGA-assisted DifuzzRTL; GoldenFuzz simulates in VCS; BenchFuzz roadmap only

capabilities.name: Multi-hart / concurrency bugs
capabilities.source: HartBreaker targets multi-hart CPUs; BenchFuzz plans a dual-hart harness

capabilities.name: Per-bug results on Encarsia
capabilities.source: Encarsia Tables 8-10 (DifuzzRTL, ProcessorFuzz, Cascade per bug); ChipFuzzer reports aggregate counts for itself, TheHuzz, Cascade and BMCFuzz; BenchFuzz per bug, replay-confirmed (Rocket, BOOM)

capabilities.name: Open source
capabilities.source: public repositories (DifuzzRTL, ProcessorFuzz, Cascade, HartBreaker); GoldenFuzz states access will be restricted; TheHuzz closed; others: no release found
